reviews.title: Works but you are required to use their terrible software.
reviews.comment: Easy to install, the required software is terrible and doesn't scale correctly on my PC so I can't really use it, but the pump works and looks cool. The pump requires a lot of power so you have to make sure your power supply is adequate.
reviews.author: jordan busbee
